ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Operation Gate
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: The UNCHANGED mod reproducing issue #40 case 3: MayRequire="joof.testharness.gate" sits directly on a PatchOperation's own <li> wrapper (inside a PatchOperationSequence), not on def content and not on a PatchOperationFindMod branch. RimWorld's list deserializer consumes that attribute before the PatchOperation object is constructed, so Verse.PatchOperation itself never sees it — the only way to capture it is at the XML-to-object deserialization boundary (ProvenanceRecorder's pendingOperationGates / RecordOperationGate). This mod and its files are identical across Run A and Run B; the ONLY change between runs is the gate mod being removed, so any flip here must be driven by Seed 6 reading a mayRequire entry populated via that path. No game content — dev/QA use only.
